links.comparator_used: the initial probability threshold used in the main simulation (the default is not stated in the abstract)
links.outcome: proportion of patients with ampicillin-susceptible Enterobacterales bacteriuria recommended an appropriate aminopenicillin dosage/regimen per EUCAST guidelines
links.effect: 79.3% (n = 276) at the initial threshold vs 96.6% (n = 336) after adjusting the probability threshold
links.quote: Adjusting the probability threshold for predicting complicated UTI increased the proportion of appropriate recommendations in bacteriuria to 96.6% (n = 336).
